name: Recent EpicKor centered title thumbnail

requiredOverlay.staticReviewScaleRule: Scale these values proportionally when the dashboard card is wider; keep the source image inspectable.

layoutRules: Card 1 must work as the Instagram grid thumbnail.
Use a centered title lockup inside a conservative safe area.
Use a short uppercase kicker above the title.
Prepare three thumbnail copy directions before selection: Mystery, Mistake, and Decision.
The selected thumbnail must create curiosity, warn about a mistake, or force a decision; it must not merely restate the blog title.
Use exactly two title lines unless the representative approves an exception.
Do not add a static subtitle below the title; live speech captions belong below the center title in render.

creativeDirections.label: Mystery
creativeDirections.purpose: Make the viewer wonder why a Korean habit, place, food, or rule works this way.

creativeDirections.label: Mistake
creativeDirections.purpose: Warn about a tourist, foreigner, shopping, food, etiquette, packing, or planning mistake.

creativeDirections.label: Decision
creativeDirections.purpose: Frame the Reel around choosing the better Korea option, route, timing, place, product, or behavior.
